query:
INSERT INTO issue_tags (id, issue_id, tag_id, project_id)
            SELECT $1, $2, $3, i.project_id
            FROM issues i
            WHERE i.id = $2
            RETURNING
                id         AS "id!: Uuid",
                issue_id   AS "issue_id!: Uuid",
                tag_id     AS "tag_id!: Uuid",
                project_id AS "project_id!: Uuid"
